limits: Six small synthetic repositories; two repetitions are nested within each task.
Manual compactions and 22-24 KB diagnostic files; not natural context exhaustion or a million-token task.
Codex CLI with gpt-5.6-luna at medium effort and the same custom base instructions in all arms.
Fresh workspaces and sessions with one authenticated profile reused per approach.
Token counters are not a bill; dollar cost is unknown.
Absent action logs mean unobserved external side effects, not proven zero.
Literal-reference audit cannot rule out indirect access.
Ranked IDs are ordered candidates, not necessarily a reduced set; delivered IDs identify context received by Codex.
All six SKU cells were replaced after an outcome-blind contract amendment; thirty unaffected cells were reused. Replacement runs occurred later. This is not an independent replication.

nativeAudit.caveat: Transcript path discovery is filename-based within each profile sessions/archived_sessions directory; zero matches are unknownDynamicPath, not evidence of no transcript. Only function/custom-tool inputs, event_msg command fields, and allowlisted turn_context metadata were inspected. The allowlist is payload.model, payload.effort/reasoning_effort, payload.approval_policy, and payload.sandbox_policy.type; all other turn_context fields are ignored. Cell tokens and automatic-quality-* run-root basenames are compared to the selected audit run. No message/output/reasoning payloads or credential values are emitted. Literal-reference matching only; dynamic or indirect path access remains unverified.
